Read the text about how the dictionary page has been written.
The teacher asks the class, “Have you noticed that the words in bold are
written one after another? OK. Do you find any rule or system or order in
arranging these words?”
“Yes, teacher. The page starts with a single letter B and gradually
words come below this letter,” Rupa said.

clear or not. OK?”
